caption: The drawing depicts a rectangular frame with a semi-circular arch at the top, composed of repeated fan-shaped segments outlined in black, lightly shaded in grey, and adorned with small dots. The frame is decorated with alternating green and red circular accents, placed at the base of each fan-shape and sometimes in pairs. Four large circular medallions, one at each corner, feature a central green and red flower-like motif with radiating black lines and more dots. Along the bottom of the frame, there is a horizontal strip with a wavy line alternating in green and red. The semi-circular arch at the top contains a larger fan-shaped element, with green and red coloring at its base and green dots at the ends of the fan sections. Overall, the drawing uses black ink lines for structure and shading, with green and red for decorative highlights. The center of the frame and the background remain uncolored.
title: Tin Frame
